name: Sivananda Yoga Vedanta Centre Chennai
reason: Started, then stopped: sivananda.org.in answered an image request (…/2026/10/sivananda-chennai-yoga-centre-kailash-colony.webp, a file the Chennai pages link) with HTTP 403 on 10 Nov 2026; my download loop then made two more image requests to the host before stopping (reported as a slip). Under the blocked-means-skip rule nothing more was taken from the host and the saved pages and photos were deleted. The centre itself looked promising (since October 1989, email chennai@sivananda.org.in in its footer, beginners', weekend and meditation courses with INR prices, open-class passes, free trial class); the owner may want to revisit.
